newsitem.title: UK: N. Brown in talks to buy Freemans.
newsitem.headline: N. Brown in talks to buy Freemans.

text.p: N. Brown Group Plc said on Thursday that it was in talks with Sears Plc with a view to acquire its Freemans home shopping unit.
N. Brown said the terms of the deal were expected to be similiar to those announced by Sears on January 13 when it was negotiating with Littlewoods.
Trading in N. Brown's share price was temporarily suspended from 1430 hours on Thursday ahead of its announcement.
N. Brown said that if the terms were agreed it would take full account of the interests of its shareholders.
Sears had earlier hoped to sell Freemans for 395 million pounds and had said it had received several approaches.
Littlewoods backed out from the deal last week but said it would return if other potential buyers were excluded.
The two companies agreed on the deal in January but the British government referred it to the Monopolies and Mergers Commission for competitions review.
